verdict.rationale: Together AI provides building blocks rather than a first-class automation feature. Asynchronous batch workloads [docs-3] and fine-tuning jobs launched via API/CLI [docs-17] do run in the background. Agent loops are possible through multi-step/multi-turn function calling [docs-9, docs-16], but the tools are executed and orchestrated in your own application [docs-8]. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered automations, hosted background agents that run autonomously on the platform, workflow orchestration or monitoring of autonomous runs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
